ambiguities_or_notes: Не прохожу, а работник remains the aphoristic ‘Not passing through, but a worker,’ without supplying an omitted subject or metaphor.
The bare German beibringen is retained; the source note gloss приводить доказательства is translated ‘to adduce evidence.’
The source's malformed final-list deletion around 7 / пьянство is preserved as malformed deletion markup in English rather than conjecturally expanding its extent.
